openapi: 3.1.1
info:
  title: Flare HTTP API
  version: 1.0.0
  summary: The contract between the Flare phone app, the server and the Telegram webhook.
  description: |
    Every endpoint the server exposes. Engineers build to this file; `npm run contracts`
    lints it and checks that every route the server registers is listed here.

    Rules that apply to every operation:

    - No accounts. A phone proves it is a member with `Authorization: Bearer {memberId}.{writeToken}`.
      The write token is 128 random bits made on the phone; the server stores only its SHA-256
      (SRS-SEC-4).
    - Every write (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE) needs an `Idempotency-Key` header. A repeat with the
      same key returns the first response and changes nothing (SRS-IF-1, SRS-REL-2).
    - Fields ending in `_ct` are AES-256-GCM ciphertext made on a phone with the group key
      (12-byte nonce prepended, base64url). The server cannot read them (ADR-0009).
    - The server never receives coordinates, readable place names, display names, free-text
      conditions or needs profiles from a link group. Places are opaque per-gathering labels
      (`spot`, `c1` to `c12`, `step:1` to `step:4`). Telegram groups are the one disclosed
      exception (ADR-0013).
    - No response shows who said yes, who is in the set, or when anyone answered. Only counts
      (BR-Q-5). A member may read their own answer through `/me`.
    - Writes are rate limited to 30 per minute per member and 300 per minute per gathering
      (SRS-SEC-5). Over the limit: 429 with `Retry-After`.
    - Times are UTC ISO 8601 with milliseconds. Every gathering view carries `server_time`
      so phones show server time, not their own clock (BR-TIME-1 to 3).
  license:
    name: AGPL-3.0-or-later
    identifier: AGPL-3.0-or-later
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:8787
    description: Local development
  - url: "{base}"
    description: Deployed server (the founder approves every deploy)
    variables:
      base:
        default: https://flare-outside.onrender.com
tags:
  - name: system
  - name: groups
  - name: gatherings
  - name: answers
  - name: arrival
  - name: places
  - name: push
  - name: ai
  - name: telegram
security: []
paths:
  /api/v1/health:
    get:
      tags: [system]
      operationId: getHealth
      summary: Liveness and dependency status
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Server is up
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Health" }

  /api/v1/config:
    get:
      tags: [system]
      operationId: getConfig
      summary: Public settings the app needs at start
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Config
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Config" }

  /api/v1/audit:
    get:
      tags: [system]
      operationId: getDeletionAudit
      summary: Deletion audit (BR-D-7), counts only
      description: |
        Counts rows past their expiry in every per-gathering store, plus totals for the
        stores that survive Gone. Passing means `expired_rows` is 0 everywhere. The website's
        privacy page shows this output (SRS-WEB-2). Cached for 60 s.
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Audit
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Audit" }

  /api/v1/groups:
    post:
      tags: [groups]
      operationId: createGroup
      summary: Create a group and its first member (SRS-ID-1, SRS-ID-3)
      description: The phone makes the group id, the 256-bit group key (never sent), the member id and the write token.
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey"
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/CreateGroup" }
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Group" }
        "400": { $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest" }
        "409": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Conflict" }
        "429": { $ref: "#/components/responses/TooMany" }

  /api/v1/groups/{groupId}:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/GroupId"
    get:
      tags: [groups]
      operationId: getGroup
      summary: Group with members (names sealed) and live gatherings
      security: [{ member: [] }]
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Group
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Group" }
        "401": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized" }
        "404": { $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound" }

  /api/v1/groups/{groupId}/members:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/GroupId"
    post:
      tags: [groups]
      operationId: joinGroup
      summary: Join from a link (SRS-ID-3); 12 members at most (SRS-ID-5)
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey"
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/NewMember" }
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Joined
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Member" }
        "400": { $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest" }
        "404": { $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound" }
        "409": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Conflict" }
        "429": { $ref: "#/components/responses/TooMany" }

  /api/v1/groups/{groupId}/members/{memberId}:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/GroupId"
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/MemberId"
    patch:
      tags: [groups]
      operationId: renameMember
      summary: Change your own sealed display name
      security: [{ member: [] }]
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey"
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required: [name_ct]
              properties:
                name_ct: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/NameCt" }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Renamed
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Member" }
        "401": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized" }
        "403": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Forbidden" }
    delete:
      tags: [groups]
      operationId: forgetGroup
      summary: Forget this group (SRS-ID-6, ADR-0015)
      description: |
        Deletes your member row, push subscription, Telegram map entry, your answers in live
        gatherings, and the Sparks you wrote (by their delete tokens). If you were the last
        member, the group, its Hot spots blob, all Sparks and counters go too.
      security: [{ member: [] }]
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey"
      requestBody:
        required: false
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              properties:
                spark_delete_tokens:
                  type: array
                  maxItems: 500
                  items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Token" }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Forgotten
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/ForgetResult" }
        "401": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized" }
        "403": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Forbidden" }

  /api/v1/groups/{groupId}/gatherings:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/GroupId"
    post:
      tags: [gatherings]
      operationId: createGathering
      summary: Send a Flare or a Plan (SRS-CRE-7, SRS-PLAN-1)
      description: |
        The host's phone makes the gathering id and seals everything readable into `sealed`
        and `notice_ct`. The host counts as one yes (BR-Q-1). Upload the photo next with
        `PUT /gatherings/{id}/photo`; the link works before the photo lands.
        Telegram groups add `telegram` with readable post text (ADR-0013).
      security: [{ member: [] }]
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey"
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/CreateGathering" }
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Sent
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Gathering" }
        "400": { $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest" }
        "401": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized" }
        "409": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Conflict" }
        "422": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Unprocessable" }
        "429": { $ref: "#/components/responses/TooMany" }

  /api/v1/gatherings/{gatheringId}:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/GatheringId"
    get:
      tags: [gatherings]
      operationId: getGathering
      summary: The shared view everyone with the link sees
      description: Anyone holding the 122-bit gathering id may read it. It holds counts and sealed data only.
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Gathering
          headers:
            ETag:
              schema: { type: string }
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Gathering" }
        "404": { $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound" }
        "410": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Gone" }

  /api/v1/gatherings/{gatheringId}/events:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/GatheringId"
    get:
      tags: [gatherings]
      operationId: streamGatheringEvents
      summary: Live updates as Server-Sent Events (asyncapi.yaml, channel gatheringEvents)
      description: |
        Sends a `gathering` event with the full view on connect and on every change, a comment
        line every 15 s, and a final `gone` event before it closes. Reconnect with
        `Last-Event-ID` (the view `version`) to skip what you have.
      parameters:
        - name: Last-Event-ID
          in: header
          required: false
          schema: { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9]{1,10}$" }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Event stream
          content:
            text/event-stream:
              schema: { type: string }
        "404": { $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound" }
        "410": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Gone" }

  /api/v1/gatherings/{gatheringId}/photo:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/GatheringId"
    put:
      tags: [gatherings]
      operationId: putPhoto
      summary: Host uploads the sealed photo (SRS-CRE-6), at most 1.5 MB
      security: [{ member: [] }]
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey"
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/octet-stream:
            schema: { type: string, contentMediaType: application/octet-stream }
      responses:
        "204": { description: Stored }
        "401": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized" }
        "403": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Forbidden" }
        "409": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Conflict" }
        "413": { $ref: "#/components/responses/TooLarge" }
    get:
      tags: [gatherings]
      operationId: getPhoto
      summary: The sealed photo; the phone opens it with the key in the link
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Ciphertext
          headers:
            Cache-Control:
              schema: { type: string, const: "private, max-age=3600, immutable" }
          content:
            application/octet-stream:
              schema: { type: string, contentMediaType: application/octet-stream }
        "404": { $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound" }
        "410": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Gone" }

  /api/v1/gatherings/{gatheringId}/me:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/GatheringId"
    get:
      tags: [answers]
      operationId: getMyAnswer
      summary: Your own answer and what you can do next
      security: [{ member: [] }]
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Your view
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Me" }
        "401": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized" }
        "404": { $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound" }
        "410": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Gone" }
    put:
      tags: [answers]
      operationId: putMyAnswer
      summary: Say yes (with 0 to 4 rules) or, after Lit, "Can't make it"
      description: |
        `yes` before Lit adds or replaces your yes and its rules (SRS-RES-3, SRS-COND-6).
        `cant_make_it` is accepted only after Lit and does not change the state (SRS-RES-6).
        Rules come from the phone's parser after the read-back was confirmed (BR-C-10).
      security: [{ member: [] }]
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey"
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Answer" }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Saved
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Me" }
        "400": { $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest" }
        "401": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized" }
        "409": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Conflict" }
        "410": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Gone" }
        "422": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Unprocessable" }
        "429": { $ref: "#/components/responses/TooMany" }
    delete:
      tags: [answers]
      operationId: takeBack
      summary: Take it back, before Lit only (SRS-RES-6)
      security: [{ member: [] }]
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Taken back
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Me" }
        "401": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized" }
        "409": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Conflict" }
        "410": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Gone" }

  /api/v1/gatherings/{gatheringId}/me/checks:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/GatheringId"
    put:
      tags: [answers]
      operationId: putMyChecks
      summary: Your phone's pass or fail per place label (BR-E-3, SRS-PLAN-6)
      description: |
        The phone checks its needs profile and walking limit against each place in the sealed
        blob and sends only pass or fail per label. The profile never leaves the phone (SRS-ACC-1).
        Missing labels count as pass after 60 s of Ember (BR-E-4).
      security: [{ member: [] }]
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey"
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Checks" }
      responses:
        "204": { description: Saved }
        "400": { $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest" }
        "401": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized" }
        "410": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Gone" }

  /api/v1/gatherings/{gatheringId}/text-yes:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/GatheringId"
    post:
      tags: [answers]
      operationId: addTextYes
      summary: Host enters a relayed "IN code" reply (SRS-CH-6, BR-ID-6)
      description: Counts as an anonymous yes with no rules. At most 3 per gathering.
      security: [{ member: [] }]
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey"
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required: [code]
              properties:
                code: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/ShortCode" }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Counted
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Gathering" }
        "403": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Forbidden" }
        "409": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Conflict" }
        "422": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Unprocessable" }

  /api/v1/gatherings/{gatheringId}/fade:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/GatheringId"
    post:
      tags: [answers]
      operationId: fade
      summary: I'm fading (Plans, BR-P-5 to BR-P-7)
      description: Once per member per Plan, from Lit until start + 50% of the current step. Nobody sees who.
      security: [{ member: [] }]
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Plan shrank one step, or stayed at step 4
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Gathering" }
        "401": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized" }
        "403": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Forbidden" }
        "409": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Conflict" }

  /api/v1/gatherings/{gatheringId}/arrivals:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/GatheringId"
    post:
      tags: [arrival]
      operationId: addArrival
      summary: I'm here, or the host's +1 (BR-H-1 to BR-H-5)
      description: |
        Accepted only while Lit. `recorded_at` is the phone's time of the tap, used only to
        accept outbox items whose tap fell inside the Lit window (SRS-OFF-3); the server
        clock decides everything else.
      security: [{ member: [] }]
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey"
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Arrival" }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Counted, or ignored at the cap
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Gathering" }
        "401": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized" }
        "403": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Forbidden" }
        "409": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Conflict" }

  /api/v1/gatherings/{gatheringId}/done:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/GatheringId"
    post:
      tags: [gatherings]
      operationId: markDone
      summary: Host ends a Lit gathering (BR-F-5, BR-P-8)
      security: [{ member: [] }]
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Gone, deletion scheduled within 5 min
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Gathering" }
        "403": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Forbidden" }
        "409": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Conflict" }

  /api/v1/gatherings/{gatheringId}/cancel:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/GatheringId"
    post:
      tags: [gatherings]
      operationId: cancelGathering
      summary: Host cancels, in Kindling or Ember only (BR-F-6)
      security: [{ member: [] }]
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Gone with "Not this time."
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Gathering" }
        "403": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Forbidden" }
        "409": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Conflict" }

  /api/v1/gatherings/{gatheringId}/live-location:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/GatheringId"
    put:
      tags: [arrival]
      operationId: putLiveLocation
      summary: Host's opt-in live location, sealed (SRS-CMP-6)
      description: Overwritten in place, no history, only while Lit, deleted at Gone. The server sees ciphertext only.
      security: [{ member: [] }]
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey"
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required: [location_ct]
              properties:
                location_ct: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/SmallCt" }
      responses:
        "204": { description: Stored }
        "403": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Forbidden" }
        "409": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Conflict" }
    get:
      tags: [arrival]
      operationId: getLiveLocation
      summary: Members of the chosen set read the host's sealed location
      security: [{ member: [] }]
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Latest sealed location
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [location_ct, at]
                properties:
                  location_ct: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/SmallCt" }
                  at: { type: string, format: date-time }
        "403": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Forbidden" }
        "404": { $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound" }
    delete:
      tags: [arrival]
      operationId: stopLiveLocation
      summary: Host stops sharing
      security: [{ member: [] }]
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey"
      responses:
        "204": { description: Deleted }
        "403": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Forbidden" }

  /api/v1/gatherings/{gatheringId}/sparks:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/GatheringId"
    post:
      tags: [places]
      operationId: addSpark
      summary: Leave a Spark after Done (BR-K-1 to BR-K-4)
      description: Only members with an accepted arrival, once per gathering. Text is 1 to 140 characters before sealing.
      security: [{ member: [] }]
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey"
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/NewSpark" }
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Saved
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Spark" }
        "403": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Forbidden" }
        "409": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Conflict" }

  /api/v1/groups/{groupId}/sparks:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/GroupId"
    get:
      tags: [places]
      operationId: listSparks
      summary: Sparks at one place, newest first (BR-K-5)
      security: [{ member: [] }]
      parameters:
        - name: place
          in: query
          required: true
          description: HMAC-SHA-256 of the place key under a key derived from the group key (base64url).
          schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/PlaceHash" }
        - name: limit
          in: query
          schema: { type: integer, minimum: 1, maximum: 20, default: 1 }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Sparks
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [sparks]
                properties:
                  sparks:
                    type: array
                    items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Spark" }
        "401": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized" }

  /api/v1/groups/{groupId}/hotspots:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/GroupId"
    get:
      tags: [places]
      operationId: getHotspots
      summary: The group's sealed Hot spots blob (BR-K-6)
      security: [{ member: [] }]
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Blob
          headers:
            ETag:
              schema: { type: string }
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Hotspots" }
        "404": { $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound" }
    put:
      tags: [places]
      operationId: putHotspots
      summary: Replace the blob; send If-Match with the version you merged into
      description: On 412 fetch, merge by max count per place on the phone (BR-K-6) and retry.
      security: [{ member: [] }]
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey"
        - name: If-Match
          in: header
          required: true
          schema: { type: string }
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required: [blob_ct]
              properties:
                blob_ct: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/BlobCt" }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Saved
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Hotspots" }
        "412": { $ref: "#/components/responses/PreconditionFailed" }

  /api/v1/groups/{groupId}/push-subscriptions:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/GroupId"
    put:
      tags: [push]
      operationId: putPushSubscription
      summary: Save this phone's Web Push subscription (SRS-IF-3)
      security: [{ member: [] }]
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey"
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/PushSubscription" }
      responses:
        "204": { description: Saved }
        "400": { $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest" }
        "401": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized" }
    delete:
      tags: [push]
      operationId: deletePushSubscription
      summary: Stop notices on this phone
      security: [{ member: [] }]
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey"
      responses:
        "204": { description: Deleted }

  /api/v1/drafts:
    post:
      tags: [ai]
      operationId: draftFromPhoto
      summary: Six words and a scene from a photo, on our laptop (ADR-0006, ADR-0011)
      description: |
        The phone sends a 768 px JPEG (quality 0.7). The server relays it to the hub in memory,
        zero-fills the buffer after the job, and stores nothing. If the hub is absent, slow
        (6 s) or its answer fails `enforce()`, the response is the template (`tier: rules`)
        and the phone shows the typed fallback (BR-AI-1). Increments `tier_ran.photo.{tier}`.
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          image/jpeg:
            schema: { type: string, contentMediaType: image/jpeg, maxLength: 1500000 }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Draft
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/DraftResponse" }
        "400": { $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest" }
        "413": { $ref: "#/components/responses/TooLarge" }
        "415": { $ref: "#/components/responses/UnsupportedMedia" }
        "429": { $ref: "#/components/responses/TooMany" }

  /api/v1/drafts/ladder:
    post:
      tags: [ai]
      operationId: draftLadder
      summary: Four step labels and minutes from a Plan's ask line (SRS-PLAN-2)
      description: |
        Hub tier with an 8 s budget, else the template ladder. The ask line is at most 80
        characters and carries no place; the phone attaches places from its map pack.
        Kept in memory only.
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/LadderRequest" }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Ladder
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/LadderResponse" }
        "400": { $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest" }
        "429": { $ref: "#/components/responses/TooMany" }

  /api/v1/groups/{groupId}/telegram-link:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/GroupId"
    post:
      tags: [telegram]
      operationId: createTelegramLink
      summary: A one-time t.me link that adds the bot to the group's chat (ADR-0013)
      description: |
        Returns `https://t.me/{bot}?startgroup={token}`. When the bot sees `/start {token}` in an
        allow-listed chat it links that chat to this group and sets `channel` to `telegram`.
        Token valid 15 min, single use, stored as a hash.
      security: [{ member: [] }]
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey"
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Link
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [url, expires_at]
                properties:
                  url: { type: string, format: uri }
                  expires_at: { type: string, format: date-time }
        "401": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized" }
        "503": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Unavailable" }

  /api/v1/gatherings/{gatheringId}/telegram-bind:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/GatheringId"
    post:
      tags: [telegram]
      operationId: bindTelegram
      summary: Join a Telegram yes to this phone's member (personal link from the bot)
      description: |
        A Telegram user who tapped "I'm in" in the chat and then opens their personal link
        (`?bind={token}`) sends the token here. The server moves that yes onto the phone's member
        so it counts once, and records the Telegram user on the member (BR-ID-5).
      security: [{ member: [] }]
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey"
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required: [token]
              properties:
                token: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Token" }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Bound
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Me" }
        "401": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized" }
        "410": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Gone" }
        "422": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Unprocessable" }

  /api/v1/telegram/webhook:
    post:
      tags: [telegram]
      operationId: telegramWebhook
      summary: Telegram Bot API updates (contracts/telegram.md)
      description: |
        Telegram sends updates here with the secret header set at setWebhook. Handled update
        types: `message` (/start, /help, any other text), `callback_query` (I'm in), and
        `my_chat_member` (added to or removed from a chat). Other chats than the allow-list are
        left and logged without content (SRS-CH-1). Free text is never parsed or stored (ADR-0013).
        Always answers 200 quickly; work that calls Telegram back runs after the response.
      security: [{ telegramSecret: [] }]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              description: A Telegram Update object (https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#update)
              required: [update_id]
              properties:
                update_id: { type: integer }
      responses:
        "200": { description: Accepted }
        "401": { $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized" }

components:
  securitySchemes:
    member:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: "{memberId}.{writeToken}"
      description: Member id (UUID) and the phone's 128-bit write token (base64url), joined by a dot.
    telegramSecret:
      type: apiKey
      in: header
      name: X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token

  parameters:
    GroupId:
      name: groupId
      in: path
      required: true
      schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Id" }
    GatheringId:
      name: gatheringId
      in: path
      required: true
      schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Id" }
    MemberId:
      name: memberId
      in: path
      required: true
      schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Id" }
    IdempotencyKey:
      name: Idempotency-Key
      in: header
      required: true
      description: Random per action, made on the phone and kept in the outbox until accepted (24 h).
      schema: { type: string, pattern: "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,64}$" }

  responses:
    BadRequest:
      description: The body or a parameter does not match this contract
      content:
        application/json:
          schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error" }
    Unauthorized:
      description: Missing or wrong member token or secret
      content:
        application/json:
          schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error" }
    Forbidden:
      description: You are a member but this action is not yours (host-only, not in the set)
      content:
        application/json:
          schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error" }
    NotFound:
      description: No such group or gathering
      content:
        application/json:
          schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error" }
    Conflict:
      description: Not allowed in the current state (see `code`)
      content:
        application/json:
          schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error" }
    Gone:
      description: The gathering ended; its data is deleted or about to be
      content:
        application/json:
          schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error" }
    PreconditionFailed:
      description: The version moved on; fetch, merge, retry
      content:
        application/json:
          schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error" }
    TooLarge:
      description: Body over its limit
      content:
        application/json:
          schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error" }
    UnsupportedMedia:
      description: Wrong content type or not a JPEG
      content:
        application/json:
          schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error" }
    Unprocessable:
      description: Well formed but breaks a business rule (see `code`)
      content:
        application/json:
          schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error" }
    TooMany:
      description: Rate limit (SRS-SEC-5)
      headers:
        Retry-After:
          schema: { type: integer }
      content:
        application/json:
          schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error" }
    Unavailable:
      description: A dependency is not configured (for example no bot token)
      content:
        application/json:
          schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error" }

  schemas:
    Id:
      type: string
      format: uuid
      description: UUID v4 made on the phone with crypto.randomUUID (122 random bits).
    Token:
      type: string
      pattern: "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{22}$"
      description: 128 random bits, base64url without padding.
    ShortCode:
      type: string
      pattern: "^[REDACTED]{5}$"
      description: BR-CH-3. Unique among live gatherings.
    Label:
      type: string
      pattern: "^(spot|c([1-9]|1[0-2])|step:[1-4])$"
      description: |
        Opaque place label inside one gathering. `spot` is the host's spot, `c1` to `c12` the Ember
        candidates in distance order, `step:k` a Plan step's place. The real places live only in
        the sealed blob (ADR-0009); OSM ids are never sent because they resolve to coordinates.
    Ct:
      type: string
      contentEncoding: base64url
      pattern: "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$"
      description: AES-256-GCM ciphertext, 12-byte nonce first, base64url.
    NameCt:
      allOf: [{ $ref: "#/components/schemas/Ct" }]
      maxLength: 200
    SmallCt:
      allOf: [{ $ref: "#/components/schemas/Ct" }]
      maxLength: 1400
    SealedCt:
      allOf: [{ $ref: "#/components/schemas/Ct" }]
      maxLength: 22000
      description: The sealed gathering blob (SealedGathering below, encrypted). At most 16 KB of plaintext.
    BlobCt:
      allOf: [{ $ref: "#/components/schemas/Ct" }]
      maxLength: 90000
    PlaceHash:
      type: string
      pattern: "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$"

    Error:
      type: object
      required: [code, message]
      properties:
        code:
          type: string
          enum:
            - bad_request
            - unauthorized
            - forbidden
            - not_found
            - gone
            - group_full
            - wrong_state
            - already_lit
            - not_host
            - not_in_set
            - fade_used
            - fade_window_closed
            - text_yes_cap
            - code_mismatch
            - not_arrived
            - spark_exists
            - plan_times
            - quorum_range
            - unknown_member
            - bind_expired
            - version_conflict
            - too_large
            - not_jpeg
            - rate_limited
            - not_configured
        message:
          type: string
          description: Plain words for logs and developers; the phone shows its own copy deck string.

    Health:
      type: object
      required: [ok, version, hub, db]
      properties:
        ok: { type: boolean }
        version: { type: string }
        hub: { type: string, enum: [connected, absent] }
        db: { type: string, enum: [ok, down, not_configured] }

    Config:
      type: object
      required: [version, vapid_public_key, telegram_bot_username, limits]
      properties:
        version: { type: string }
        vapid_public_key:
          type: [string, "null"]
          description: null when push is not configured; the app then relies on the bot or the open page.
        telegram_bot_username: { type: [string, "null"] }
        limits:
          type: object
          required: [max_members, max_photo_bytes, flare_quorum, plan_quorum]
          properties:
            max_members: { type: integer, const: 12 }
            max_photo_bytes: { type: integer, const: 1500000 }
            flare_quorum: { type: array, items: { type: integer }, const: [2, 3, 4] }
            plan_quorum: { type: array, items: { type: integer }, const: [2, 3, 4, 5, 6] }

    Audit:
      type: object
      required: [at, pass, stores]
      properties:
        at: { type: string, format: date-time }
        pass: { type: boolean, description: "true when every per-gathering store has 0 expired rows" }
        stores:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            required: [store, table, per_gathering, total_rows, expired_rows]
            properties:
              store: { type: string, description: "Logical store id, DS1 to DS11" }
              table: { type: string }
              per_gathering: { type: boolean }
              total_rows: { type: integer }
              expired_rows: { type: integer }

    CreateGroup:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [id, member]
      properties:
        id: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Id" }
        member: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/NewMember" }

    NewMember:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [id, name_ct, write_token]
      properties:
        id: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Id" }
        name_ct: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/NameCt" }
        write_token:
          allOf: [{ $ref: "#/components/schemas/Token" }]
          description: Sent once; the server keeps only SHA-256 of it.

    Member:
      type: object
      required: [id, name_ct, joined_at, via]
      properties:
        id: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Id" }
        name_ct:
          description: null for a member the bot made from a Telegram tap; the app shows "A Telegram friend".
          oneOf:
            - $ref: "#/components/schemas/NameCt"
            - type: "null"
        joined_at: { type: string, format: date-time }
        via: { type: string, enum: [link, telegram] }

    Group:
      type: object
      required: [id, channel, members, live]
      properties:
        id: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Id" }
        channel: { type: string, enum: [link, telegram] }
        members:
          type: array
          maxItems: 12
          items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Member" }
        live:
          type: array
          description: Gatherings that are not Gone.
          items:
            type: object
            required: [id, kind, state]
            properties:
              id: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Id" }
              kind: { type: string, enum: [flare, plan] }
              state: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/State" }

    State:
      type: string
      enum: [kindling, lit, ember, gone]

    PlanStep:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [step, minutes, place]
      properties:
        step: { type: integer, minimum: 1, maximum: 4 }
        minutes: { type: integer, minimum: 5, maximum: 600 }
        place: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Label" }

    CreateGathering:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [id, kind, quorum, tz, sealed, notice_ct]
      properties:
        id: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Id" }
        kind: { type: string, enum: [flare, plan] }
        quorum:
          type: integer
          minimum: 2
          maximum: 6
          description: Flare 2 to 4 (default 2); Plan 2 to 6 (default 3). Checked against kind (422 quorum_range).
        tz:
          type: string
          description: IANA time zone of the host's phone (BR-TIME-2)
          maxLength: 64
        sealed: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/SealedCt" }
        notice_ct:
          allOf: [{ $ref: "#/components/schemas/SmallCt" }]
          description: Sealed NoticeText; copied into push payloads so the service worker can show names (ADR-0014).
        ember_candidates:
          type: array
          description: Flares only. Labels c1..cN in distance order from the spot, N at most 12, all within 400 m (BR-E-1, picked on the phone).
          maxItems: 12
          items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Label" }
        plan:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: false
          required: [start_at, deadline_at, steps]
          properties:
            start_at: { type: string, format: date-time }
            deadline_at: { type: string, format: date-time }
            steps:
              type: array
              minItems: 4
              maxItems: 4
              description: Steps 1 to 4, minutes strictly decreasing (BR-P-4).
              items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/PlanStep" }
        telegram:
          description: Only for groups with channel telegram (ADR-0013). Readable, kept until Gone.
          type: object
          additionalProperties: false
          required: [host, invite, place, link]
          properties:
            host: { type: string, maxLength: 40 }
            invite: { type: string, maxLength: 80 }
            place: { type: string, maxLength: 120 }
            link:
              type: string
              format: uri
              maxLength: 300
              description: The gathering link with its key fragment, posted on the bot's buttons.

    Gathering:
      type: object
      required: [id, group_id, kind, state, quorum, need, short_code, version, created_at, state_since, server_time, sealed, notice_ct, has_photo]
      properties:
        id: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Id" }
        group_id: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Id" }
        kind: { type: string, enum: [flare, plan] }
        state: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/State" }
        quorum: { type: integer, description: "2 in Ember (BR-E-5)" }
        need: { type: integer, minimum: 0, description: "Need N more (BR-Q-4)" }
        short_code: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/ShortCode" }
        version: { type: integer, minimum: 1, description: "Goes up by 1 on every change; SSE event id" }
        created_at: { type: string, format: date-time }
        state_since: { type: string, format: date-time }
        next_change_at:
          type: [string, "null"]
          format: date-time
          description: When the server clock will move the state next (Ember, Gone, Plan deadline)
        server_time: { type: string, format: date-time }
        sealed: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/SealedCt" }
        notice_ct: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/SmallCt" }
        has_photo: { type: boolean }
        headcount: { type: [integer, "null"], description: "From Lit on (BR-H-1)" }
        ember_choice:
          description: The chosen Ember label once Ember starts (BR-E-1 to BR-E-4); `spot` when none qualified.
          oneOf:
            - $ref: "#/components/schemas/Label"
            - type: "null"
        plan:
          type: [object, "null"]
          required: [start_at, deadline_at, current_step, steps]
          properties:
            start_at: { type: string, format: date-time }
            deadline_at: { type: string, format: date-time }
            current_step: { type: [integer, "null"], minimum: 1, maximum: 4 }
            steps:
              type: array
              items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/PlanStep" }
        ended:
          type: [string, "null"]
          enum: [not_this_time, thanks_for_coming, null]
          description: Set at Gone. Identical for every member (SRS-ST-3).

    Me:
      type: object
      required: [member_id, answer, rules, ember_only, in_set, arrived, can_take_back, can_fade, still_coming, is_host]
      properties:
        member_id: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Id" }
        is_host: { type: boolean }
        answer: { type: string, enum: [none, yes, cant_make_it] }
        rules:
          type: array
          maxItems: 4
          items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Rule" }
        ember_only: { type: boolean }
        in_set:
          type: [boolean, "null"]
          description: Whether you are in the chosen set. null before Lit. Only ever about you.
        arrived: { type: boolean }
        can_take_back: { type: boolean }
        can_fade: { type: boolean }
        still_coming:
          type: boolean
          description: |
            true after a fade made one of your own rules fail at the new step (OQ-2, ADR-0016).
            You stay in; the phone shows "Plan changed to {step}. Still coming?" once.

    Rule:
      description: BR-C-1 plus min_step (ADR-0016). Times are absolute UTC, worked out on the phone in the group time zone.
      oneOf:
        - type: object
          additionalProperties: false
          required: [type, member_id]
          properties:
            type: { const: with }
            member_id: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Id" }
        - type: object
          additionalProperties: false
          required: [type, at]
          properties:
            type: { const: after }
            at: { type: string, format: date-time }
        - type: object
          additionalProperties: false
          required: [type, at]
          properties:
            type: { const: back_by }
            at: { type: string, format: date-time }
        - type: object
          additionalProperties: false
          required: [type, minutes]
          properties:
            type: { const: max_walk }
            minutes: { type: integer, minimum: 1, maximum: 120 }
        - type: object
          additionalProperties: false
          required: [type, step]
          properties:
            type: { const: max_step }
            step: { type: integer, minimum: 1, maximum: 4 }
        - type: object
          additionalProperties: false
          required: [type, step]
          properties:
            type: { const: min_step }
            step: { type: integer, minimum: 1, maximum: 4 }

    Answer:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [answer]
      properties:
        answer: { type: string, enum: [yes, cant_make_it] }
        rules:
          type: array
          maxItems: 4
          default: []
          items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Rule" }
        ember_only:
          type: boolean
          default: false
          description: '"Count me in for a closer one" (BR-A-3). Carries no reason.'
        checks: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Checks" }

    Checks:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [results]
      properties:
        results:
          type: object
          description: Label to pass (true) or fail (false).
          propertyNames: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Label" }
          additionalProperties: { type: boolean }
          maxProperties: 17

    Arrival:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [for, recorded_at]
      properties:
        for: { type: string, enum: [self, member, someone_else] }
        member_id:
          allOf: [{ $ref: "#/components/schemas/Id" }]
          description: Required when `for` is member (host only).
        recorded_at: { type: string, format: date-time }

    NewSpark:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [id, place, text_ct, delete_token]
      properties:
        id: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Id" }
        place: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/PlaceHash" }
        text_ct:
          allOf: [{ $ref: "#/components/schemas/Ct" }]
          maxLength: 800
        delete_token:
          allOf: [{ $ref: "#/components/schemas/Token" }]
          description: Kept on the phone; lets "Forget this group" remove your Sparks without the server knowing who wrote them.

    Spark:
      type: object
      required: [id, text_ct, created_on]
      properties:
        id: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Id" }
        text_ct: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Ct" }
        created_on: { type: string, format: date, description: "Day only (DS10 rule: nothing finer than the day)" }

    Hotspots:
      type: object
      required: [blob_ct, version]
      properties:
        blob_ct: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/BlobCt" }
        version: { type: integer, minimum: 1 }

    PushSubscription:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [endpoint, keys]
      properties:
        endpoint: { type: string, format: uri, maxLength: 1000 }
        keys:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: false
          required: [p256dh, auth]
          properties:
            p256dh: { type: string, maxLength: 200 }
            auth: { type: string, maxLength: 50 }

    ForgetResult:
      type: object
      required: [last_member, sparks_deleted]
      properties:
        last_member: { type: boolean, description: "true when the group and everything in it was deleted" }
        sparks_deleted: { type: integer }

    DraftResponse:
      type: object
      required: [invite, alt, tier, ms]
      properties:
        invite: { type: string, description: "At most 6 words, no emoji, no person words (enforce())" }
        alt: { type: string, description: "At most 20 words; the photo's accessible name (SRS-ACC-5). Empty on the rules tier." }
        tier: { type: string, enum: [hub, rules] }
        ms: { type: integer, minimum: 0 }

    LadderRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [ask, total_minutes]
      properties:
        ask: { type: string, minLength: 1, maxLength: 80 }
        total_minutes: { type: integer, minimum: 20, maximum: 600, description: "Step 1 length the host picked" }

    LadderResponse:
      type: object
      required: [steps, tier, ms]
      properties:
        steps:
          type: array
          minItems: 4
          maxItems: 4
          items:
            type: object
            required: [step, label, minutes]
            properties:
              step: { type: integer, minimum: 1, maximum: 4 }
              label: { type: string, maxLength: 40, description: "At most 4 words" }
              minutes: { type: integer, minimum: 5 }
        tier: { type: string, enum: [hub, rules] }
        ms: { type: integer, minimum: 0 }

    SealedGathering:
      description: |
        Plaintext inside `sealed`, never sent unsealed. Listed here so phone engineers share one shape.
        Encrypted with the group key, AAD = gathering id.
      type: object
      required: [v, host_name, invite, scene, host_line, spot]
      properties:
        v: { const: 1 }
        host_name: { type: string, maxLength: 40 }
        invite: { type: string, maxLength: 80 }
        scene: { type: string, maxLength: 200 }
        host_line: { type: string, maxLength: 120 }
        spot: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/SealedPlace" }
        candidates:
          type: object
          description: Ember candidates c1..c12
          additionalProperties: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/SealedPlace" }
        steps:
          type: object
          description: Plan steps step:1..step:4
          additionalProperties:
            type: object
            required: [name, place]
            properties:
              name: { type: string, maxLength: 40 }
              place: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/SealedPlace" }
        nature_line: { type: string, maxLength: 120 }
        access: { type: object, description: "Counts and nearest distances for the access line (SRS-ACC-2)" }
        photo_key_hint: { type: string, description: "none; the photo uses the same group key with AAD = gathering id + ':photo'" }

    SealedPlace:
      type: object
      required: [name, lat, lon, key]
      properties:
        name: { type: string, maxLength: 120 }
        lat: { type: number }
        lon: { type: number }
        key: { type: string, description: "Place key: OSM element id, else the name (BR-K-4)" }

    NoticeText:
      description: Plaintext inside `notice_ct`; the service worker decrypts it to write the notice.
      type: object
      required: [v, host, spot]
      properties:
        v: { const: 1 }
        host: { type: string, maxLength: 40 }
        spot: { type: string, maxLength: 120 }
        benches:
          type: object
          description: Ember label to bench name, for "Smaller plan: 15 min at {bench}."
          additionalProperties: { type: string, maxLength: 120 }
        steps:
          type: object
          description: Plan step label to step name, for "Smaller plan: {step}."
          additionalProperties: { type: string, maxLength: 40 }

input.content:
asyncapi: 3.0.0
info:
  title: Flare live channels
  version: 1.0.0
  description: |
    The two live channels. `npm run contracts` parses this file with @asyncapi/parser.

    1. **Hub relay** (`/hub`, WebSocket). The Mac hub dials out to the server and holds the
       socket open; the server sends AI jobs down it. Nothing on the Mac listens on a port
       (ADR-0006). Code: packages/shared/src/hub-protocol.ts, apps/server/src/hub/relay.ts,
       apps/hub/src/client.ts.
    2. **Gathering events** (`/api/v1/gatherings/{gatheringId}/events`, Server-Sent Events).
       Phones get the shared view on every change (ADR-0014).

    Telegram updates arrive by HTTPS webhook and are in openapi.yaml and telegram.md.
    Web Push payloads are below as the `push` channel, sent through the browser's push service.
  license:
    name: AGPL-3.0-or-later
defaultContentType: application/json
servers:
  local:
    host: localhost:8787
    protocol: ws
    description: Local development; the hub uses FLARE_SERVER_URL.
  deployed:
    host: flare-outside.onrender.com
    protocol: wss
    description: TLS from day one. The founder approves every deploy.
    security:
      - $ref: "#/components/securitySchemes/hubSecret"

channels:
  hub:
    address: /hub
    title: Hub relay
    description: |
      One socket at a time; a new hub replaces the old one (close code 4000). Text frames are
      JSON control messages. A photo job is a `job` text frame followed by exactly one binary
      frame holding the JPEG. Max frame 2 MB. The server pings every 20 s; the hub reconnects
      with backoff from 1 s up to 30 s. A job with no result in 6 s (photo) or 8 s (ladder)
      falls back to the rules tier on the server (BR-AI-1).
    servers:
      - $ref: "#/servers/local"
      - $ref: "#/servers/deployed"
    bindings:
      ws:
        method: GET
        headers:
          type: object
          required: [Authorization]
          properties:
            Authorization:
              type: string
              description: "Bearer {HUB_SECRET}; compared in constant time. Wrong or missing: HTTP 401, no upgrade."
    messages:
      hello: { $ref: "#/components/messages/hello" }
      photoJob: { $ref: "#/components/messages/photoJob" }
      photoBytes: { $ref: "#/components/messages/photoBytes" }
      ladderJob: { $ref: "#/components/messages/ladderJob" }
      result: { $ref: "#/components/messages/result" }
      ping: { $ref: "#/components/messages/ping" }
      pong: { $ref: "#/components/messages/pong" }

  gatheringEvents:
    address: /api/v1/gatherings/{gatheringId}/events
    title: Gathering events (SSE)
    description: |
      `text/event-stream`. On connect: one `gathering` event with the full view. On every change:
      another `gathering` event (id = view version). Every 15 s: a `: keepalive` comment. At Gone:
      a final `gone` event, then the server closes. Reconnect with `Last-Event-ID`; if that
      version is current the server sends nothing until the next change. Phones also poll
      `GET /gatherings/{id}` every 30 s while the page is visible, so a dropped stream costs at
      most 30 s, inside SRS-SOL-3's 5 s only when the stream is up.
    parameters:
      gatheringId:
        description: Gathering UUID
    messages:
      gathering: { $ref: "#/components/messages/gatheringView" }
      gone: { $ref: "#/components/messages/gone" }

  push:
    address: web-push
    title: Web Push payload
    description: |
      Encrypted to the subscription with RFC 8291 and sent with VAPID (RFC 8292). TTL 600 s,
      urgency high for `lit`. The service worker reads the group key from IndexedDB, opens
      `notice_ct`, and writes the notice from the copy deck ("It's lit. {host} is at {spot}.").
      If it can't (no key on this phone, decrypt fails), it shows the fallback
      ("It's lit. Open Flare to see where."). iOS requires a visible notice for every push.
    messages:
      notice: { $ref: "#/components/messages/pushNotice" }

operations:
  hubSaysHello:
    action: send
    channel: { $ref: "#/channels/hub" }
    summary: Hub announces its model and whether it is warm
    messages:
      - $ref: "#/channels/hub/messages/hello"
  serverSendsPhotoJob:
    action: receive
    channel: { $ref: "#/channels/hub" }
    summary: Server sends a photo job header, then the JPEG as one binary frame
    messages:
      - $ref: "#/channels/hub/messages/photoJob"
      - $ref: "#/channels/hub/messages/photoBytes"
  serverSendsLadderJob:
    action: receive
    channel: { $ref: "#/channels/hub" }
    summary: Server sends a Plan ladder job (text only)
    messages:
      - $ref: "#/channels/hub/messages/ladderJob"
  hubSendsResult:
    action: send
    channel: { $ref: "#/channels/hub" }
    summary: Hub answers a job
    messages:
      - $ref: "#/channels/hub/messages/result"
  serverPings:

The host's phone builds these lines and hands them to the share sheet ("Copy as text"). The server never sees them. A friend with no data or on satellite texting reads the line and replies `IN {code}` to the host, who taps it in (SRS-CH-6).

## Forms

| Form | Template | Example (bytes) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Flare | `FLARE {code} {spot}. Need {n} more. Reply IN {code}. Ends {time}` | `FLARE K7Q2M Ford Woods Park pond. Need 1 more. Reply IN K7Q2M. Ends 3:40PM` (75) |
| Plan | `PLAN {code} {ask} Need {n} more. Reply IN {code} by {time}` | `PLAN K7Q2M Fairlane walk at 11? Need 2 more. Reply IN K7Q2M by 10:40AM` (71) |
| Lit | `LIT {code} {host} is at {spot}.` | `LIT K7Q2M Fuego is at Ford Woods Park pond.` (44) |
| Reply | `IN {code}` | `IN K7Q2M` (8) |

## Rules

1. **Length.** Every form is at most 200 bytes of UTF-8 (BR-CH-2). One free field takes the cut: `{spot}` for Flare and Lit, `{ask}` for Plan. The host name is capped at 40 bytes by the create form.
2. **Cut mark.** A cut field ends in `...` (three ASCII full stops), not `…`. `…` is not in the GSM-7 alphabet, so one would switch the whole text to UCS-2 and split it into 3 segments. Cutting removes whole code points, so the result is always valid UTF-8.
3. **Code.** 5 characters from `REDACTED` (31 symbols, no 0, 1, I, L, O), made with rejection sampling from `crypto.getRandomValues`. Unique among live gatherings (database partial unique index `gatherings_live_code`). 31^5 = 28,629,151 codes.
4. **Time.** `{time}` is the server's next-change time in the group time zone, formatted `h:mmAM` with no space (saves a byte, stays readable).
5. **Spaces.** Runs of whitespace in a field become one space.
6. **Reply parsing.** `parseReply` accepts `IN` and a code in any case with any spacing around them (`in k7q2m`, ` IN   K7Q2M `). Anything else returns `null` and the host sees "That's not a Flare code."
7. **Counting.** A reply the host taps in is an anonymous yes: no member id, no rules. At most 3 per gathering (BR-ID-6). The host's phone sends `POST /api/v1/gatherings/{id}/text-yes` with the code; the server checks it matches the gathering (`422 code_mismatch`) and the cap (`409 text_yes_cap`).

## Proof

- Every named spot in the pinned Fairlane result fits with no cut: the longest is 89 bytes (Henry Ford Academy & Windmill Park), from docs/content/03-checks.md.
- Tests cover: the PRD example exactly, 150 two-byte characters cut to at most 200 bytes, an ASCII spot staying GSM-7 after a cut, 80 four-byte emoji with no broken character, the Plan and Lit forms, a bad code refused, reply parsing, and 200 random codes matching the alphabet.

# 03 Telegram bot behavior

> **Status: live group test not yet run.** It is blocked on one human step: someone sends `/start@FairlaneFlareBot` in the private "Flare test" group so the bot learns the group's chat ID. Privacy mode is on, so the bot sees only commands. Everything below marked **verified live** was measured. Everything marked **docs** comes from the official Bot API pages and will be replaced by live results.

## Question

Using our bot and only the private "Flare test" group, can we:
1. post a message with inline buttons
2. answer button taps privately, so only the tapper sees the answer
3. edit the message to update a count
4. make a new post that notifies the group
5. delete the bot's own posts
6. use a deep-link `/start` for private messages

What are the exact behaviors and limits?

## Verified live so far (2026-10-10)

- `getMe`: bot `@FairlaneFlareBot`. `can_join_groups: true`, `can_read_all_group_messages: false` (privacy mode on), `supports_inline_queries: false`.
- `getWebhookInfo`: no webhook set, 0 pending updates. `getUpdates` works (no 409 conflict).
- `getUpdates` returned 0 updates. The bot has seen no message from the group in the last 24 h, so the chat ID cannot be found yet.
- Every call is logged with the token redacted (`spikes/03-telegram/results/api-log.jsonl`). A grep for the token prefix in the log: 0 matches.

## What the test script does (`spikes/03-telegram/tg.mjs run --chat <id>`)

It refuses to run unless `getChat` says the title is "Flare test". Then:

1. `sendMessage` with an inline keyboard (`I'm in (n)` / `Not now`), callback data `flare:yes` / `flare:no`. Sent with `disable_notification: true`, so the setup post doesn't ping.
2. Posts a deep link `https://t.me/FairlaneFlareBot?start=p_test123`, also silent.
3. Long-polls `getUpdates` (25 s) for the test window. On each tap:
   - `answerCallbackQuery`: a toast for "yes", a modal alert for "no", `cache_time: 0`. Only the tapper sees it.
   - `sendMessage` with `ephemeral_message_parameters: {receiver_user_id, callback_query_id}`: a group message only the tapper sees (Bot API 10.2+).
   - `editMessageText` of the shared message with the new yes count.
   - At 2 yes (QUORUM_FLARE): a new `sendMessage` **without** `disable_notification`, so the group is notified.
4. Handles `/start p_test123` in private chat by replying with the payload.
5. Sends the same edit again, to record the "message is not modified" error.
6. `deleteMessage` on one post, then `deleteMessages` (bulk) on the rest.
7. `tg.mjs cleanup` confirms the update offset (stops polling) and calls `deleteWebhook`, leaving the bot clean for the build session.

## Facts from the official docs (to confirm live)

Sources: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api , https://core.telegram.org/bots/api-changelog , https://core.telegram.org/bots/features , https://core.telegram.org/bots/faq (checked 2026-10-10)

- **Current version:** Bot API 10.3 (2026-08-24).
- **Ephemeral messages (10.2, 2026-07-14):** a bot can send group messages visible only to one user and the bot.
  - 10.3 bundles the fields into `EphemeralMessageParameters {receiver_user_id, callback_query_id?, replace_callback_query_message?}`.
  - "It is not guaranteed that the user will receive the message, especially if they are offline."
  - `Message.message_id` is 0 for ephemeral messages; they carry `ephemeral_message_id`.
  - Edits use `editEphemeralMessage*`; deletion uses `deleteEphemeralMessage`.
  - An ephemeral message can only be replied to within 15 s of being sent.
- **`callback_data`:** 1–64 bytes.
- **`answerCallbackQuery`:** text 0–200 characters. `show_alert` shows a modal instead of a toast. The client shows a progress spinner until you answer, so answer every tap fast.
- **Editing:** sending the same text and markup again returns 400 "message is not modified" (community-documented error text).
- **Deleting:** "A message can only be deleted if it was sent less than 48 hours ago." Bots can delete their own messages in groups. `deleteMessages` takes 1–100 IDs.
- **Notifications:** `disable_notification` sends silently. A normal bot post notifies members according to their own chat settings.
- **Rate limits (FAQ):** about 1 message per second per chat, 20 messages per minute per group, about 30 per second overall. Over that gives 429 with `retry_after`.
- **Deep links:** `t.me/<bot>?start=<payload>`, payload up to 64 characters from `A-Z a-z 0-9 _ -`. The bot receives `/start <payload>` in private chat. A bot cannot message a user who has never started it (403 "bot can't initiate conversation with a user", community-documented).
- **Polling vs webhook:** they are mutually exclusive. `getUpdates` fails while a webhook is set. Updates are kept until confirmed, but not longer than 24 hours.
- **Privacy mode:** in groups the bot gets commands, replies to itself and service messages. Callback queries from its own buttons arrive as `callback_query` updates either way.

## Recommendation (provisional, until the live run)

- **Private answers:** use `answerCallbackQuery` as the guaranteed private reply (always shown to the tapper). Add an ephemeral message only as a bonus, since delivery is not guaranteed and older Telegram clients may not show it.
- **Edit, don't repost:** keep one group message per flare and edit its count. Post a new, notifying message only when the flare lights or shrinks to the smaller plan. That stays well under 20 messages per minute per group.
- **Clean up:** delete the flare's messages when it expires after 1 hour (well inside the 48 h window), using `deleteMessages` in one call.
- **Private flows:** use deep links (`?start=<flareId>`) for anything needing a private DM, such as location sharing. The user must tap Start once before the bot can DM them.
- **One poller or one webhook:** pick webhook for the deployed server, and never run a local poller at the same time.

## Update 2026-10-10 evening

- The listener ran for about 70 minutes and was stopped on request. `getUpdates` returned 0 updates on all 75 calls, so the "bot was added" (`my_chat_member`) update is no longer stored (Telegram keeps updates at most 24 h), or the bot was never added. Without a chat ID no group test could run.
- Polling is stopped and `deleteWebhook` was called (webhook: none, pending 0), so the build session can take the bot over.
- **One command for the morning**, run from `lab/`:
  ```bash
  node spikes/03-telegram/tg.mjs morning --minutes 60 --taps 10
  ```
  Steps:
  1. Waits up to 60 min for anyone's `/start@FairlaneFlareBot` in "Flare test", then saves the chat ID.
  2. Automatic part (no taps needed):
     - post with buttons
     - edit the count 0 → 1 → 2
     - same-text edit (records the "not modified" error)
     - a notifying post
     - single `deleteMessage`, bulk `deleteMessages`, and a second delete of an already-deleted message (records the error)
  3. Tap part, 10 min: two people tap "I'm in", one taps "Not now", one opens the deep link. This records the toast/alert answers, ephemeral messages, the live count edits, the "lit" notifying post and the `/start` payload.
  4. `cleanup`: confirms the offset and deletes the webhook.
- Each part can also run alone: `tg.mjs basic --chat <id>`, `tg.mjs run --chat <id> --minutes 10`, `tg.mjs cleanup`.

## Next step

1. Someone sends `/start@FairlaneFlareBot` in "Flare test". The listener writes `spikes/03-telegram/results/chat.json`.
2. Run `node spikes/03-telegram/tg.mjs run --chat <id> --minutes 10`, with two people tapping "I'm in" and one opening the deep link.
3. Run `node spikes/03-telegram/tg.mjs cleanup`, then fill this report from `results/api-log.jsonl`.

# Contract: Telegram bot

Version 1.0, Sat 2026-10-10. Bot API 10.3 (checked 2026-10-10, lab report 03). Bot: `@FairlaneFlareBot`, privacy mode on. Webhook: `POST /api/v1/telegram/webhook` (openapi.yaml). Decision: [ADR-0013](../adr/0013-telegram-readable-posts.md). Copy: `bot.*` keys in the copy deck, listed in docs/content/06-channels.md.

## 1. Setup

| Step | Call | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Deploy | `setWebhook(url=https://{host}/api/v1/telegram/webhook, secret_token=TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET, allowed_updates=["message","callback_query","my_chat_member"], drop_pending_updates=true)` | Run by `npm run -w apps/server telegram:webhook` after the founder approves the deploy. Polling and webhook are exclusive; no local poller may run at the same time |
| Every update | Compare header `X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token` with `TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET` in constant time | Wrong or missing: 401, nothing logged but `tg.refused` |
| Allow-list | `TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_CHAT_IDS`, comma list | At release: only "Flare test" (BR-CH-1) |

The handler answers 200 within 1 s and does the Telegram calls after the response, so Telegram never retries a slow update. Each update id is processed once (idempotency table, key `tg:{update_id}`).

## 2. Linking a chat to a group

1. In the app, the host taps "Add to Telegram". The phone calls `POST /api/v1/groups/{groupId}/telegram-link` and opens `https://t.me/FairlaneFlareBot?startgroup={token}`.
2. The host picks the chat. Telegram adds the bot and posts `/start@FairlaneFlareBot {token}` there.
3. The bot gets the `message`. If the chat id is allow-listed and the token is live (15 min, single use), it sets `groups.telegram_chat_id` and `groups.channel = 'telegram'`, and replies `bot.start.hello`, `bot.start.what`.
4. If the chat is not allow-listed, the bot calls `leaveChat`, logs `{event: "tg.refused", reason: "not_allow_listed"}` with no chat title or content, and does nothing else (SRS-CH-1). The same happens on `my_chat_member` for any unlisted chat.

Before step 1 the app shows the disclosure: Telegram will see what Flare posts there (the photo, the six words, the place, the host's first name and the count).

## 3. Posting a gathering

At `createGathering` for a Telegram group, the phone sends `telegram: {host, invite, place, link}` in plain text. The server keeps it in `gatherings.telegram_plain` until Gone (deleted with the row), and:

1. `sendPhoto` to the chat with the photo the phone uploads for Telegram (the same 768 px JPEG it sent for the draft, kept in memory for this call only), caption:
   ```
   {invite}
   {host} · {place}
   Need {n} more. Nobody sees who.
   Open until {time}.
   ```
   and an inline keyboard:
   - `[I'm in]` callback data `y:{gatheringId}` (38 bytes, under the 64-byte cap)
   - `[Add a condition]` callback data `c:{gatheringId}`
   - `[Open in Flare]` URL button: `{link}?via=tg` (the fragment carries the key, which is why ADR-0013 discloses it)
2. Saves `(chat_id, message_id)` in `bot_messages`.

No photo arrives: the post goes out as `sendMessage` with the same text and keyboard. The photo for Telegram is never stored on the server.

## 4. Taps

| Update | Bot does | Private reply (answerCallbackQuery, `cache_time: 0`) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `y:{id}` from a new Telegram user | Makes a member (`via = telegram`, `name_ct = null`, `telegram_user_id`), records a yes with no rules, runs the solver | `bot.cb.yes` "You're in. Only you see this." If the user never started the bot: `bot.cb.yesNoChat` |
| `y:{id}` again | Nothing | `bot.cb.already` |
| `c:{id}` | Makes (or reuses) the member, creates a bind token (10 min) | Answers with `url = https://t.me/FairlaneFlareBot?start=b_{token}`: Telegram opens the private chat. Bonus: an ephemeral group message to that user with the same link (delivery not guaranteed, Bot API 10.2) |
| `/start b_{token}` in private | Replies with one URL button `[Add a condition]` → `{link}?via=tg&bind={token}` | The link page opens, the phone joins, calls `telegram-bind`, and the condition flow runs on the phone, read back as usual |
| Any other private text | Drops it unread: not parsed, not stored, not logged | Replies `bot.dm.link` "I don't read messages. Add conditions on the Flare page." with the same `[Add a condition]` button when one gathering is open, else `bot.dm.nothingOpen` |
| `/help` | | `bot.help` |

Free text is never parsed on the server (founder decision, ADR-0013). That keeps BR-C-9 true for Telegram too: conditions are made only by the phone's rules parser.

## 5. Updates to the post

- Count changes: `editMessageCaption` (or `editMessageText`) with the new "Need N more." and the same keyboard, at most once per 3 s per message (coalesced), well under 20 messages a minute per group. "message is not modified" (400) is ignored.
- Lit: edit the post to "It's lit. {host} is at {place}.", remove the I'm in and condition buttons, then send one new notifying message `bot.post.lit` to the chat so phones buzz. DM each Telegram member of the chosen set who started the bot: `bot.dm.lit`.
- Ember: edit to `bot.post.ember` with the bench name the phone included in `telegram.place_ember` (sealed groups never send it), and send one notifying message.
- Plan smaller: edit to "Smaller plan: {step}."

## 6. Cleanup at Gone (BR-D-3, SRS-CH-4)

1. Edit the post to the final line ("Not this time." or "Thanks for coming.").
2. Within the 5-minute window of BR-D-1, `deleteMessages(chat_id, [all message_ids])` in one call (1 to 100 ids). Every post is under 36 h old (BR-P-1), inside Telegram's 48 h delete limit.
3. Delete the `bot_messages` rows. The gathering row (with `telegram_plain`) is deleted by the sweeper; `ON DELETE CASCADE` takes the rest.
4. A failed delete is retried 3 times over 2 min, then logged as `{event: "tg.delete_failed", count}` with no ids.

## 7. Limits we rely on

| Limit | Value | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Messages per group | 20 per minute | Bot FAQ, lab report 03 |
| Callback data | 1 to 64 bytes | Bot API |
| answerCallbackQuery text | 0 to 200 characters | Bot API |
| Delete window | 48 h after sending | Bot API |
| deleteMessages | 1 to 100 ids | Bot API |
| Deep-link payload | up to 64 of `A-Z a-z 0-9 _ -` | Bot features page |

cd "<project>/flare" && cat > README.md <<'EOF'
# Flare

Snap where you are. If enough friends quietly say yes, it's on.

Flare is an installable web app for small groups of friends (2 to 12). A host sends a photo of where they are, or a Plan for later. Friends say yes in private, with conditions if they like ("after 2", "only with Amor"). It lights only when enough people can come, it shrinks to a smaller plan instead of failing, it works for friends with low vision or limited mobility and with no signal, and it deletes itself within 5 minutes of ending.

Built for the DEV Hacktoberfest Open-Source AI Challenge, Week 1 "Touch Grass". Field-tested near Fairlane Town Center, Dearborn MI, on four iPhones.

## Run it yourself

Needs Node 24.21.0 or later ([.nvmrc](.nvmrc)), and for the photo AI a Mac (or any machine with a GPU) running [Ollama](https://ollama.com).

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Hotragn/flare-outside && cd flare-outside
npm ci
cp .env.example .env        # then fill in HUB_SECRET (any 32+ random characters)
npm run check-env           # reports set or missing, never values
npm run build && npm start  # server and web app on http://localhost:8787
```

The AI hub, in a second terminal on the machine with Ollama:

```bash
ollama pull gemma4:e4b-it-q4_K_M
npm run hub
```

Then open http://localhost:8787/hello/, pick a photo, and six words come back from the model in about 3.5 s. `npm run e2e:hello` does the same with Chrome and checks the answer.

Postgres is optional for local runs (`DATABASE_URL`); tests use an in-memory Postgres (PGlite).

## Scripts

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `npm run ci` | Secret scan, lint, types, tests, contract checks, build, JS budget. Same as GitHub Actions |
| `npm test` | Vitest, all workspaces |
| `npm run contracts` | Lints [openapi.yaml](docs/architecture/contracts/openapi.yaml), parses [asyncapi.yaml](docs/architecture/contracts/asyncapi.yaml), checks the server's routes against them |
| `npm run e2e:hello` | Phone page, server, hub relay, Ollama and back, in headless Chrome |
| `npm run check-env [-- server hub bot]` | Which settings are set or missing, per app |
| `npm run hooks` | Installs the pre-push secret scan |

## Layout

| Path | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| [apps/server](apps/server) | Hono HTTP API, hub relay WebSocket, Postgres schema |
| [apps/hub](apps/hub) | Runs next to Ollama, dials out to the server, drafts six words from a photo in memory |
| [apps/web](apps/web) | SvelteKit app: the phone app and the link page |
| [packages/shared](packages/shared) | Code both sides use: photo prompt and `enforce()`, short codes, plain-text SMS forms, hub protocol |
| [docs/](docs) | Research, product, requirements, brand, design, content, [architecture](docs/architecture/README.md), handoffs |
| [design/prototype](design/prototype) | Clickable prototype of all 33 screens |

## Privacy in one paragraph

The group key lives in the link's `#fragment`, which browsers never send to servers. Photos, names, places, coordinates and Sparks are sealed on the phone (AES-256-GCM) before upload. Conditions are parsed on the phone and only the rule is sent. To write the six words the photo goes to our laptop over an encrypted link and is held in memory only. Groups that choose Telegram trade some of this for convenience, and the app says so before they do. Full details: [security and privacy design](docs/architecture/08-security-privacy.md).
